en: So you made the climb. I'm Grant, Leader of the Cyllage Gym.
On a rock face you look for the next hold, and then the one after it. One mistake and you start again from the bottom.
A battle is the same. Show me how you climb!
You never once lost your grip. That's a climb I'd be proud of.
Here. The Cliff Badge is yours, proof that you reached the top of the Cyllage Gym.
{player} received the Cliff Badge from Grant!
Take this too. My Pokémon use it to bury a foe's feet in stone and slow it right down.
There's more of Kalos to climb. Keep looking for the next hold.
Every morning I climb this wall and think of our battle. I still haven't found where I slipped.
Hello there, future Champion! Grant's Rock types shrug off fire and flight. Bring water, grass or a good fist!
You beat Grant! You must have hands of iron.
